rows.label: style
rows.help: Orbit: ring timeline around the cube. Mono: compact lanes.

rows.label: mode
rows.help: Light or dark for the whole site. System follows your device.

rows.label: F2L pairs
rows.help: Pseudo pairs count pairs solved with a D offset.

rows.label: OLL
rows.help: 2-look splits OLL into edges (EO) then corners (CO).

rows.label: PLL
rows.help: 2-look splits PLL into corners (CP) then edges (EP).

rows.label: inspection
rows.help: WCA gives 15 s. Off starts the clock on your first turn.

rows.label: overtime
rows.help: What happens when inspection runs over.

rows.label: callouts
rows.help: Judge calls at 8 s and 12 s.

rows.label: voice
rows.help: Speak the callouts with a local device voice. no offline voice installed; callouts stay silent.

rows.label: scramble
rows.help: Guided cues each move. Paste uses your scramble. Free starts from your scramble.

rows.label: cross hint
rows.help: Show a suggested cross during inspection.

rows.label: cross color
rows.help: Search all six faces for the shortest cross, or choose one color to limit the search.

rows.label: timer
rows.help: Hide the running clock to focus on the cube.

rows.label: stats source
rows.help: Choose which solve sources appear in comparisons and stats.
